podcast.body: This rock classic from 1978 is cited as an example of punk-influenced or punk-adjacent rock, with its intro being compared to the bubblegum classic "Yummy, Yummy, Yummy" by The Ohio Express, released 10 years prior. "Okay, now listen to the intro to just what I needed This is the rock classic from the cars who I would consider kind of punk adjacent Definitely punk influenced This 10 years later in 1978."
